discovers.title: The Great Wall at Badaling
discovers.subtitle: Morning hike
discovers.description: The Great Wall winds over green mountains. Walking the Great Wall at sunrise is unforgettable, and the old watchtowers tell stories of ancient China.

discovers.title: Mogao Caves
discovers.subtitle: Silk Road art
discovers.description: The Mogao Caves near Dunhuang keep Buddhist murals of the Silk Road. Ancient painters decorated the caves for a thousand years.

discovers.title: Forbidden City
discovers.subtitle: Palace of emperors
discovers.description: The Forbidden City is a huge palace museum. The red walls and golden roofs of the palace shine in the sun. Ancient emperors lived in this palace.

discovers.title: Temple of Heaven
discovers.subtitle: Ancient ceremonies
discovers.description: The Temple of Heaven is where emperors prayed for good harvests. The round temple is a masterpiece of ancient architecture.

discovers.title: West Lake
discovers.subtitle: Boat trip
discovers.description: West Lake in Hangzhou is famous for its gardens and pagodas. A boat trip on the lake shows temples, bridges and willow trees.

discovers.title: Li River
discovers.subtitle: Karst mountains
discovers.description: The Li River flows between karst mountains. A bamboo raft on the river is the best way to see the mountains and villages.

discovers.title: Terracotta Army
discovers.subtitle: Xi'an museum
discovers.description: The Terracotta Army museum in Xi'an has thousands of soldiers. The museum shows ancient craftsmanship of the Qin dynasty.

discovers.title: Potala Palace
discovers.subtitle: Lhasa
discovers.description: The Potala Palace stands high above Lhasa. This palace has more than a thousand rooms and a long history.

discovers.title: Summer Palace
discovers.subtitle: Imperial garden
discovers.description: The Summer Palace is a royal garden with a lake and long corridors. The garden and the lake are beautiful in every season.
